name: @cachet/rp
description: Example relying party. Run twice (A and B) to show two independent apps verifying the same identity.

scripts.dev:a: concurrently -k -n api,ui "RP=a tsx --conditions=@cachet/source watch server/main.ts" "VITE_RP=a vite --config web/vite.config.ts --port 5174 --strictPort"
scripts.dev:b: concurrently -k -n api,ui "RP=b tsx --conditions=@cachet/source watch server/main.ts" "VITE_RP=b vite --config web/vite.config.ts --port 5175 --strictPort"
scripts.build: VITE_RP=a vite build --config web/vite.config.ts --outDir ../dist/a && VITE_RP=b vite build --config web/vite.config.ts --outDir ../dist/b
